newsitem.title: USA: Sodak Gaming sets two-for-one stock split.
newsitem.headline: Sodak Gaming sets two-for-one stock split.

text.p: Sodak Gaming Inc said Friday its board of directors declared a two-for-one stock split in the form of a stock dividend of one share for every one share outstanding.
The dividend will be payable September 27 to holders of record on September 13.
Prior to the dividend there were 11,366,650 shares outstanding. After the dividend, there will be about 22,733,300 shares outstanding.

"The stock split is intended, in part, to increase the liquidity of the stock and also reflects the record operating results reported during 1995 and the first half of our current calendar year," Michael Wordeman, chairman, said in a statement.
